name: agent-watch
description: An Agents pane beside the chat, in SIGMAorbital: this session and its sub-sessions (the task-orchestrator run, Workflow runs, delegating subagents) as a tree, each with a progress bar and its own colour, its subagents in that colour and pulsing while they work, what each is doing, a toast when one fails, and a clickable task-progress meter above the prompt.
